title: Scroll-Fund
tagline: Scroll-Fund is a platform where user can create on chain profile and incentivize.
description:
Scroll--Fund: Create Your On-Chain Profile and Receive Donations on Scroll Chain

Scroll--Fund is a decentralized application (dApp) that allows users to create their own on-chain profiles and receive donations in Scroll's native cryptocurrency, SCROL. With Scroll--Fund, you can:

Create an on-chain profile and get your unique ENS domain:Establish your identity in the Scroll ecosystem with a personalized ENS domain that links directly to your profile.

Receive donations in SCROL:Share your profile with a wider audience and seamlessly receive SCROL tokens as donations.

Personalize your donation messages: Add a unique touch to each donation with personalized messages.

Enjoy secure and efficient on-chain data storage:Your profile data is securely stored on the Scroll blockchain, ensuring privacy and transparency.

Benefit from a common on-chain profile aggregator: Scroll--Fund's smart contract aggregates on-chain profiles, making it easy to discover and connect with other users.
how_its_made:
this project uses scroll chain which is L2 chain and in front end we are using Next.js. we have used WAGMI for contract integration and tailwind for styling. for better ui we have used chakra. also this is my first web 3 project which is live and working on vercel...  ;)

the benefits of Scroll-Fund: Scroll--Fund addresses the limitations of centralized platforms like Buy-Me-A-Coffee, where users face high platform fees and centralized data storage. With Scroll--Fund, you can:

Eliminate platform fees: All transactions are peer-to-peer on the Scroll blockchain, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees.

Secure your data on the blockchain: Your profile data is stored on the blockchain, ensuring security, privacy, and transparency.

Mint your own ENS domain: Obtain your unique ENS domain at a minimal cost, establishing your identity in the Scroll ecosystem.

Scroll--Fund: The Secure and Efficient On-Chain Profile Solution

Scroll--Fund offers a comprehensive solution for on-chain profiles, encompassing:

Admin-only dashboard access: Only authorized administrators can access the dashboard to view transaction logs.

Easy profile access via ENS domains: Share your ENS domain to provide seamless access to your profile.

Privacy and security:Your data and identity remain secure and private.

Transparent and forgery-proof profiles:On-chain profiles ensure transparency and prevent forgery.

Complete on-chain deployment: From profile creation to deployment, everything resides securely on the Scroll blockchain.

Embrace the decentralized future of identity and donations with Scroll--Fund on Scroll Chain. Create your on-chain profile, receive SCROL donations, and experience the benefits of secure, transparent, and efficient blockchain technology.
